input.summary: Add Licensor IP/misconduct indemnity and narrow the one-way Licensee indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs one way only, and Article XIII disclaims any Licensor liability for infringement, so we carry all IP risk in technology we do not control. We have added a standard Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents and wilful misconduct (with notice/control/cooperation and procure-modify-replace-refund remedies), and narrowed our own indemnity to our content and our breach of law. If preferred, we can accept the usual exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and a super-cap of 3x annual fees on the Licensor indemnity.

The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, tender control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the indemnified party may be made without its prior written consent) and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. If the Licensed Technology becomes, or in Licensor's opinion is likely to become, the subject of an infringement claim, Licensor shall at its expense procure for Licensee the right to continue using the Licensed Technology, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, or, if neither is commercially reasonable, refund the fees paid by Licensee.
